explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares LLM evaluation (LAVE metric using GPT-4) with human judgments by computing agreement percentages and Pearson correlation coefficients between model and human performance across countries.

prompts.notes: LLM prompt used for LAVE metric is provided in Appendix L

guidelines.notes: Human evaluation guidelines with 5-point scale and instructions provided in Appendix H

sample_size.notes: Validation performed on 1,455 questions with three or more human answers

quantitative_scores.notes: LAVE judgment agrees with human judgment 79% of the time for GPT-4
LAVE judgment agrees with human judgment 73% of the time for GEMINI
LAVE judgment agrees with human judgment 76% of the time for INTERN-VL
Correlation between human and model performance across countries
Correlation between human and model performance across countries

validation_results.summary_finding: LLM evaluation using LAVE metric shows high agreement with human judgments (73-79%) and strong correlation with human performance trends across countries (Pearson r=0.69-0.75 for closed-source models).

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluations assess similar criteria of correctness, specificity, and precision through the same LAVE metric framework, while humans also provide baseline performance metrics based on cultural knowledge.
